acceptedFindings.title: Primary result not reported in manuscript
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The manuscript fails to report the correlation coefficient and p-value, the core findings. Readers cannot assess the association without these numbers.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report the Pearson r=0.658, p<0.001, and n=240 in the Results section. Include confidence interval and effect size interpretation.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Verify manuscript now contains the numeric correlation and p-value.

acceptedFindings.title: Manuscript incorrectly claims no estimates available
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md:Limitations: No estimate-like records were available...
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: This false statement misleads reviewers and readers about the existence of numerical results. It indicates a flawed automated generation.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Correct the limitation to reflect that estimates exist but were not reported. Alternatively, remove the incorrect sentence.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Search for 'No estimate-like records were available' in manuscript.md.

acceptedFindings.title: Pearson correlation assumptions (linearity, normality, homoscedasticity) not verified prior to use
evidenceRefs: diagnostics.json only reports test=pearson and n=240
figure-qa.json reports scatterplot nonBlankRatio=0.06 suggesting visualization problems
no normality or residual diagnostics provided
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The reported correlation (r=0.66, p≈0) may be invalid if the relationship is non-linear or if outliers influence the coefficient. Without diagnostic plots and tests, the inference is unsupported.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Produce and inspect a scatterplot with a LOWESS smoother; examine Q–Q plots of both variables; check for heteroscedasticity; if assumptions are violated, switch to Spearman rank correlation or robust regression.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Open correlation-scatter.png and inspect for an elliptical point cloud; any curvature or fanning invalidates Pearson.

acceptedFindings.title: No diagnostics for Pearson correlation assumptions
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Pearson correlation assumes linearity, homoscedasticity, and bivariate normality. Without checks, the reported correlation may be misleading if assumptions are violated.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Add diagnostic plots (residuals vs fitted, Q-Q plot) and tests (e.g., Shapiro-Wilk) to the run. Include these outputs in the manuscript or supplementary.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if diagnostics.json contains more than just 'test' and 'n'; look for skew, kurtosis, outlier detection.

acceptedFindings.title: No pre-specified analysis plan; exploratory posture
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without a pre-registered analysis, the risk of p-hacking is high. The result may be cherry-picked from multiple exploratory tests.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Create and bind an AnalysisSpec or method-selection artifact before claiming confirmatory findings. Or clearly label as exploratory and limit inference.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if binding artifact exists and is referenced.

acceptedFindings.title: No description of cohort construction or variable definitions
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot assess selection bias, measurement validity, or generalizability. The complete-case approach is mentioned but not quantified.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide inclusion/exclusion criteria, missing data patterns, and definitions of severity and outcome_cont. Report descriptive statistics.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Presence of a table 1 with demographics and clinical characteristics.

acceptedFindings.title: Association not adjusted for confounders
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The observed correlation may be confounded by other variables, leading to spurious inference. This limits any practical interpretation.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Either acknowledge unadjusted association, or perform multivariable analysis if confounders available. Report adjusted estimates.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if the analysis spec includes covariate adjustment.

acceptedFindings.title: Exploratory analysis presented as a confirmatory question
evidenceRefs: stats-qa.json: binding unbound and result-posture warning
manuscript.md title and abstract pose a definite research question
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: An unregistered, post-hoc analysis cannot support confirmatory claims. Presenting it as such risks over-interpretation and false discoveries.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Label the entire analysis as 'Exploratory' in the title and abstract. Explicitly state that no pre-specified analysis plan exists and that results should not be treated as hypothesis tests.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: stats-run.json binding.status = 'unbound'; confirm no AnalysisSpec or method-selection artifact.

acceptedFindings.title: Variables 'severity' and 'outcome_cont' lack operational definitions
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without knowing the measurement scale, units, and clinical meaning of severity and the continuous outcome, the correlation of 0.66 is uninterpretable.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a data dictionary detailing scale, range, coding, and clinical interpretation for both variables. If severity is ordinal, reconsider the choice of Pearson.

acceptedFindings.title: Scatterplot nonBlankRatio of 0.06 indicates a nearly blank figure
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: A scatterplot that is 94% white space cannot serve its purpose of visually confirming the bivariate relationship; it may indicate a rendering error or data points outside the axis limits.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Manually inspect the PNG file. If blank or truncated, regenerate with appropriate axis limits encompassing all data points and re-check nonBlankRatio.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Open the file directly and confirm that data points are visible and axis scales match the data range.

acceptedFindings.title: Bivariate Pearson ignores potential confounders
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json: only severity and outcome_cont, adjusted_for empty
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without adjusting for demographic or clinical covariates, the estimated correlation may reflect confounding rather than the direct association of interest.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Either add relevant covariates in a partial correlation or regression model, or explicitly discuss plausible confounders and the limitation of the unadjusted estimate.

acceptedFindings.title: Scatterplot not available for reviewer inspection
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: We cannot visually assess the linearity and potential outliers. The figure-qa only checks technical rendering, not data patterns.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Include the scatterplot in the manuscript or provide direct access. Overlay a loess smoother to check linearity.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Presence of scatterplot with smooth line in the report.

acceptedFindings.title: Complete‑case analysis without assessment of missing‑data mechanism
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: If missingness is related to severity or outcome, the correlation may be biased. Even if the dataset is full, this must be documented.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report the proportion of missing values per variable and the missing‑data pattern. Justify why complete‑case analysis is appropriate or add multiple imputation as a sensitivity analysis.

acceptedFindings.title: No reference to prior estimates or clinical relevance of the correlation magnitude
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md contains no citations or literature comparison
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: A correlation of 0.66 may be strong or weak depending on the research field; without external context, the practical importance cannot be judged.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Add a brief discussion of comparable effect sizes from published studies and the clinical meaning of the observed association.

acceptedFindings.title: Limitation says 'No reader‑facing paper/manuscript artifact was found' yet the document is a manuscript
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: This templated error diminishes trust in the manuscript’s version control and accuracy.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Remove or correct this limitation to reflect the actual artifact status.

finding.title: No code or dependency information for full reproducibility
finding.whyItMatters: Without code, the exact computation may differ; artifact hashes ensure fidelity only if the pipeline is shared.
finding.actionableFix: Provide the execution script or container specification. For now, the artifacts are sufficient for audit but not for recomputation.
finding.deterministicVerification: Check for a code artifact (e.g., .py, .R, Dockerfile) in the run directory.

rejectedFindings.reason: Low-severity single-reviewer finding kept as advisory but not accepted for automatic repair.
